description: Find the op or recipe for a job, or read the details of one. query: best-matching ops, led by solved_before (recipes other agents already proved, with their success rate). op: that op's full contract (args schema, behavior, worked examples). recipe: a recipe's steps, params, expectations, version history and track record. No arguments: every op by category with a one-line intent. Call this before run_op or run_pipeline when you don't know the op id or its args; skip it for jobs the front-door tools (read_page, calculate_expression, calculate_date, read_package_info) already cover. Reads only this server's catalog: no network, no side effects. An unknown op or recipe returns a did-you-mean suggestion. Pass one of query, op or recipe (if several, op wins, then recipe); accepts filters ops by input type, alone or with query. To read everything at once instead, use the resource extcord://catalog.

accepts.description: With or without query: only ops that take this input type (text, html, json, list, table, number, boolean).

op.description: An op id, e.g. 'extract_tables', for its full contract.

query.description: Words describing the job, e.g. 'html table to rows' or 'decode base64'.

recipe.description: A recipe name, e.g. 'page_tables', for its definition and track record.

name: discover_ops

ops.description: query: matching ops (id, intent, accepts, returns).

ops_by_category.description: No arguments: every op id and intent.

recipe.description: recipe: steps, params, example, expect, history.

solved_before.description: query: recipes that already did this, with their track record.

track.description: recipe: status, success_rate, runs and agents in 30 days.
